shunit2-2.1.8.lib is the shunit2 script of the upstream release tag v2.1.8 (2020-03-29),
https://github.com/kward/shunit2/blob/v2.1.8/shunit2, released under the Apache License 2.0.
Upstream sha256 of that file: d8f8fb2caff6e3ff77cea8837d1ae5e4fed857fe2948f9859f24f72c43814c28.
The only change is that the first line, the "#! /bin/sh" shebang, is removed: shUnit2 is a library that
is sourced, never executed, and the lab gate checks every file that has a shebang with ShellCheck and shfmt,
which would rewrite a vendored file. The remaining 1342 lines are byte-identical to upstream lines 2-1343.
Do not edit this file; the lab tests assert the behavior of exactly this version.
